_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Spigot egg in pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Spigot
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Spigot, the Minecraft Java server that runs Bukkit and Spigot plugins. Built from SpigotMC's source with its own BuildTools on install, checked against SpigotMC's checksum, with tuned Java settings.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Spigot. SpigotMC only publishes its server as source, so this
# builds it with SpigotMC's BuildTools, on the Java it asks for (Eclipse
# Temurin, checked against Adoptium's checksum). Worlds, plugins and
# settings are never touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new
# one has built.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server jar from $DL_PATH"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$DL_PATH"
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    rm -f .raptor-java .raptor-spigot
    echo "Installed."
    exit 0
fi

version="${DL_VERSION:-latest}"
[ -n "$version" ] || version=latest
info=$(get "https://hub.spigotmc.org/versions/$version.json" 2>/dev/null) || {
    get "https://hub.spigotmc.org/versions/latest.json" >/dev/null || fail "SpigotMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    fail "Spigot has no Minecraft $version. Set Version to latest, or to a Minecraft version Spigot builds, such as 1.21.4."
}
build=$(jq -r '.name' <<<"$info")
# SpigotMC's builds are reproducible, and it publishes the jar's SHA-256
# (builds from before 2023 don't have one).
sum=$(jq -r '.hashes.Spigot // empty' <<<"$info")

# The Java versions this build supports, as class file versions (52 is
# Java 8). Builds older than the field are Java 8.
min=$(jq -r '(.javaVersions[0] // 52) - 44' <<<"$info")
max=$(jq -r '(.javaVersions[1] // 52) - 44' <<<"$info")
jdk=""
for v in 25 21 17 11 8; do
    if [ "$v" -ge "$min" ] && [ "$v" -le "$max" ]; then jdk=$v; break; fi
done
[ -n "$jdk" ] || jdk=$max

# The same build is already installed: nothing to do.
read -r had_version had_build had_mc 2>/dev/null < .raptor-spigot || true
if [ -f "$jar" ] && { { [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; } || [ "${had_version:-} ${had_build:-}" = "$version $build" ]; }; then
    echo "$min" > .raptor-java
    echo "Spigot ${had_mc:-$version} (SpigotMC build $build) is already installed."
    exit 0
fi

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=x64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=aarch64 ;;
    *) fail "Spigot can't be built on this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

# The JDK and the build need about 1 GB, more than the install's small
# /tmp holds, so they go in a folder in the server's, removed at the end.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -p "$work/tmp"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
cd "$work"

echo "Downloading Java $jdk to build Spigot with"
temurin=$(get "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/$jdk/hotspot?architecture=$arch&image_type=jdk&os=linux&vendor=eclipse") ||
    fail "Adoptium can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
link=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.link' <<<"$temurin")
jdksum=$(jq -r '.[0].binary.package.checksum' <<<"$temurin")
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o jdk.tar.gz "$link"
[ "$(sha256sum jdk.tar.gz | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$jdksum" ] || fail "The Java download didn't match Adoptium's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
mkdir jdk
tar -xzf jdk.tar.gz -C jdk --strip-components=1
rm jdk.tar.gz
export JAVA_HOME="$work/jdk" PATH="$work/jdk/bin:$PATH"
# BuildTools runs Maven and the decompiler as Java programs of their own,
# so each gets a share of the memory instead of the default quarter.
export JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS="-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=40.0 -Djava.io.tmpdir=$work/tmp" HOME="$work"

echo "Downloading BuildTools"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o BuildTools.jar https://hub.spigotmc.org/jenkins/job/BuildTools/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/target/BuildTools.jar ||
    fail "SpigotMC's BuildTools can't be downloaded right now. Reinstall to try again."

echo "Building Spigot $version (SpigotMC build $build). This takes a few minutes."
if ! java -jar BuildTools.jar --rev "$version" --output-dir "$work/out" --final-name spigot.jar > build.log 2>&1; then
    tail -n 30 build.log
    fail "BuildTools couldn't build Spigot $version (the end of its log is above). It needs at least 1.5 GB of memory; give the server more, then reinstall."
fi
[ -f out/spigot.jar ] || { tail -n 30 build.log; fail "BuildTools finished without a Spigot jar. Reinstall to try again."; }
if [ -n "$sum" ] && [ "$(sha256sum out/spigot.jar | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$sum" ]; then
    fail "The jar BuildTools built doesn't match SpigotMC's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi

# BuildTools says which Minecraft version "latest" was.
mc=$(grep -o 'minecraftVersion=[^,)]*' build.log | head -n 1 | cut -d= -f2) || true
[ -n "$mc" ] || mc=$version

cd /mnt/server
mv -f "$work/out/spigot.jar" "$jar"
echo "$version $build $mc" > .raptor-spigot
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$min" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed Spigot $mc (SpigotMC build $build). It needs Java $min or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.4, or latest for the newest one Spigot builds. Reinstall the server after changing it; building takes a few minutes and at least 1.5 GB of memory.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of building it, which only staff can set.
